panels.caption: Finding a steady moment at home helps Isla set her pace before a busy day starts.
Standing on the chilly platform, she glances at her phone to see Lena's text about meeting later.
She waits for the first move that proves itself.
Killer changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.
The checked move holds, and the rest of the day has more room.
Finding a steady nook by the glass, Isla lets the rainy afternoon fade into the background.
